name: Harem Fantasy! ~Chuunibyou ga Yuusha ni Natte Osananajimi ya Hime, Maou to Amaicha H na Kozukuri Bouken♪~
original_name: は～れむふぁんたじ～！ ～中二病が勇者になって幼馴染や姫、魔王と甘イチャHな子作り冒険♪～
source:
One day you, a hormone-addled mess of teenage fantasies, are transported to a truly fantastic world.

Together with your beautiful childhood friends you accept the princess's request to save the world.

Everything here is imbued with magical powers that are enhanced by imagination... that is to say, basically, your ecchi thoughts manifest in the real world!

How can you NOT go on a babymaking journey!?

Thus, the hero's (infamous?) adventures shall be transcribed for history...
Gather your strength! The spoiled sweet ero harem life begins now! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE123731.html]DLsite English[/url]]
